name: Cars and convertibles
subtitle: Street traffic and getaway rides
summary: Sedans, sports cars, vans and drop-tops fill Vice City's streets. Convertible roofs are a real mechanic this time.

facts.text: Convertibles with working roof mechanics, plus cars and vans, were shown in the Extended Look.
Sports-car racing is one of the side activities shown.
Trailer 2 was captured in-game on a PlayStation 5, so every vehicle in it is in-engine.

name: '55 Vapid Stanier
subtitle: Vintage Vice City Pack
summary: A classic 1950s sedan that comes with every pre-order, along with a personal garage near Ocean Beach.

facts.text: Included in the Vintage Vice City Pack together with the Shore Court garage near Ocean Beach.
The Vintage Vice City Pack is included with all pre-orders and any purchase before November 20, 2026.

name: '95 Grotti Cheetah
subtitle: Ultimate Edition
summary: A 1990s supercar exclusive to the Ultimate Edition.

facts.text: Listed among the Ultimate Edition's exclusive vehicles.
Rockstar describes the Ultimate Edition as an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons and apparel threaded through Jason and Lucia's story.

name: '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy
subtitle: Ultimate Edition
summary: A 1960s muscle car turned off-road buggy, bundled with the Paradise Garage in the Ultimate Edition.

facts.text: Included in the Ultimate Edition with the Paradise Garage.

name: Motorcycles, dirt bikes and scooters
subtitle: Two wheels
summary: Dirt-bike racing in the backcountry, scooters in the city and a biker scene out in Port Gellhorn.

facts.text: Dirt biking, dirt-bike racing and scooter riding were shown in the Extended Look.
Port Gellhorn is home to a biker crowd.

name: Boats, jet skis and airboats
subtitle: On the water
summary: Leonida is mostly coastline and swamp, and the vehicle list shows it: jet skis off Vice City, airboats through Grassrivers, boats through the Keys.

facts.text: Jet skiing, kayaking, airboating and boating through the swamps all appear in the Extended Look.
